infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: UNDERGROUND uses your location to verify territory runs you start.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: UNDERGROUND may record background GPS only during an active verified run.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: UNDERGROUND uses the camera for verified-run evidence photos and private garage media you choose to upload.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: UNDERGROUND accesses your photo library only when you add private garage media.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: UNDERGROUND may save capture evidence you approve to your photo library.
